reason: This plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is to control outbound web access for two DeepSeek Harness tools (`web_fetch` and `web_search`) through configurable allow/deny patterns, with optional audit or enforcement and generated decision records. Evidence shows it is integrated as a mounted harness plugin and exports a report CLI, while also stating the policy scope is limited and does not cover other tool or model channels.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中对 web_fetch 与 web_search 请求进行可配置的允许/拒绝管控，并提供审计/执行模式与决策记录查询功能。
summaries.en: This plugin adds configurable allow/deny controls for DeepSeek Harness web_fetch and web_search requests, with audit/enforce modes and command-line reporting of decisions.

capabilities: Apply allowlist/denylist policy to web_fetch and web_search call contexts
Record per-request verdicts in JSONL OCSF-format logs
Provide CLI-based reporting and suggestion output from logged network decisions
Support audit and enforce modes for policy behavior

reasons.code: README states the plugin is an egress policy that allows/denies hosts for web_fetch and web_search at connect time, with modes including audit and enforce.
The package includes a CLI binary `dsh-netguard` and `report`-style usage in documentation, indicating exported reporting capability.
Repository packaging includes a DSH bundle patch for mounting into a profile, confirming it is an installed out-of-repo plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
README explicitly documents that control applies only to web_fetch/web_search and not to other execution paths such as bash/run_code, indicating a defined and limited scope.

capabilities: Apply allowlist/denylist policy to web_fetch and web_search call contexts
Record per-request verdicts in JSONL OCSF-format logs
Provide CLI-based reporting and suggestion output from logged network decisions
Support audit and enforce modes for policy behavior
